Krea2_Anything2RealCharacters V3 — ComfyUI 工作流程指南

此工作流程专门配置用于Krea2_Anything2RealCharacters-V3，使用 AI Toolkit 通过 KV-Cache 技术进行训练。它允许您将任何 2D、动画或风格化艺术品转换为具有极高一致性的逼真图像。

请注意：此图像到图像工作流程的运行方式与标准文本到图像设置不同。请按照以下指南进行正确配置。

📦 所需模型和资产

  1. LoRA模型:

    • 下载: Krea2_Anything2RealCharacters - v3.0 |奇维泰

    • 放置.安全张量文件到你的ComfyUI/模型/loras/目录。

  2. 基础架构（模型、CLIP、VAE）:

    • 下载: 舒适-Org/Krea-2 |抱脸

    • 下载 Krea 2 官方配重并将其放置在各自的位置模型/检查点（或diffusion_models), 模型/剪辑, 和型号/VAE文件夹。

🧩 基本自定义节点（强制）

关键：请勿替换或省略这两个节点！它们对于正确的 KV 缓存功能对齐和图像缩放至关重要。

  • Krea 2 Ostris 编辑模型补丁:

    • 存储库: ostris/ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-编辑

    • 功能：处理 Krea 2 的实验性 AI Toolkit KV 缓存编辑修补。

  • Easy_QwenEdit2509:

    • 存储库: 卡登罗/easy_qwenEdit_2509

    • 功能：解决尺寸偏移和图像尺寸限制。

⚙️ 节点参数配置及建议

  • 颜色校正节点:

    • 提示: 测试表明稍微降低输入图像的饱和度可显着提高最终的真实感。调整预色彩平衡可以让您在图像转换之前控制整体摄影色调。

  • LayerUtility：ImageScaleByAspectRatio V2:

    • 提示：设置最大侧面分辨率（最长边） 这里。我们建议将其保留在1024 像素和 2048 像素实现速度和高精度细节之间的最佳平衡。

  • Krea 2 Ostris 编辑模型补丁:

    • 提示: 保留kv_缓存严格启用/开启。禁用 KV 缓存将导致图像一致性严重丧失，从而导致输出模糊或损坏。

Krea2_Anything2RealCharacters V3 — ComfyUI Workflow Guide

This workflow is specially configured forKrea2_Anything2RealCharacters-V3, trained with KV-Cache technology using AI Toolkit. It allows you to transform any 2D, anime, or stylized artwork into photorealistic images with extreme consistency.

Please note:This image-to-image workflow operates differently from standard Text-to-Image setups.Follow the guide below for proper configuration.

📦 Required Models & Assets

  1. LoRA Model:

    • Download: Krea2_Anything2RealCharacters - v3.0 | Civitai

    • Place the.safetensorsfile into yourComfyUI/models/loras/directory.

  2. Base Architecture (Model, CLIP, VAE):

    • Download: Comfy-Org/Krea-2 | Hugging Face

    • Download official Krea 2 weights and place them in their respectivemodels/checkpoints(ordiffusion_models), models/clip, andmodels/vaefolders.

🧩 Essential Custom Nodes (Mandatory)

CRITICAL: Do NOT replace or omit these two nodes! They are essential for proper KV-cache feature alignment and image scaling.

  • Krea 2 Ostris Edit Model Patch:

    • Repository: ostris/ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit

    • Function: Handles the experimental AI Toolkit KV-cache edit patching for Krea 2.

  • Easy_QwenEdit2509:

    • Repository: cardenluo/easy_qwenEdit_2509

    • Function: Resolves dimension offsets and image size limitations.

⚙️ Node Parameter Configurations & Recommendations

  • Color Correct Node:

    • Tip: Testing shows thatlowering the saturation slightly on the input image significantly boosts final realism. Adjusting pre-color balance allows you to control the overall photographic tone before image conversion.

  • LayerUtility: ImageScaleByAspectRatio V2:

    • Tip: Set your maximum side resolution (Longest Edge) here. We recommend keeping it between1024px and 2048pxfor optimal balance between speed and high-precision detail.

  • Krea 2 Ostris Edit Model Patch:

    • Tip: Keepkv_cachestrictly ENABLED/ON. Disabling KV-cache will result in a severe loss of image consistency, leading to blurry or broken outputs.
